t: You're looking at numbers 12 and 13 Stratford Place, in Westminster. The architect was Richard Edwin, a British architect active in Marylebone, who died in 1778. He also designed the other buildings along this street that you may have passed, numbers 2 to 7 and 8 to 10. There isn't much more in my notes, so I'll keep it short. Have a look at the frontage and see how it relates to its neighbours.
